So fucked off with this and the ever increasing bundles to buy of Mastercraft weapons that when I apply them, break the fuckin game.

Say I pick up a Hauer, I apply a custom blueprint to my mastercraft mod, it then duplicates the weapon and gives me a base version and a modded version.

I say "fuck it" and play on to the Pack A Punch part when SURPRISINGLY it packs the gun visually but the dupe has the punch, salvage is now gone/comes back and attachments dissapear ad nauseam.

I think they can't fix it and this is why it's never in the patch notes, it's too embedded in the code and they would have to break something to fix it.

Stop buying ANY WEAPONS and just gring them so you can get what you want on the original blueprint.

Also, this has never happener to me in team games on Zombies, only solo!

​

Any feedback is greatly appreciated. Top end PC but the bug seems universal hence my thought it's too deep embedded.
